methodologyNotes: Covers standalone business/enterprise indoor and outdoor wireless access points that bridge a wired LAN to Wi-Fi clients and are centrally managed (on-prem controller or cloud). Excludes all-in-one consumer routers, whole-home mesh kits, gateways with WAN/routing, and smartphone-tethered hotspots. Price is typical US MSRP in USD (AP only; PoE injector/adapter not included unless noted). wifiStandard is the generation enum: 'Wi-Fi 6', 'Wi-Fi 6E', or 'Wi-Fi 7'. radioBands is the concurrent radio count enum: 'dual-band' (2.4+5 GHz), 'tri-band' (2.4+5+6 GHz), or 'quad-band'. maxAggregateRateGbps is the vendor's summed maximum PHY data rate across all bands, in Gbps (not real-world throughput). mimoConfig is the per-radio spatial-stream configuration as a string (e.g. '2x2', '4x4'). uplinkSpeedGbps is the speed of the fastest wired Ethernet uplink port, in Gbps. poeInput is the minimum PoE class required to fully power the unit: '802.3af', '802.3at', or '802.3bt'. maxPowerConsumptionW is peak power draw in watts. maxConcurrentClients is the vendor-rated maximum simultaneous client count (integer); null if not disclosed. antennaType is 'internal' or 'external'. mountEnvironment is the rated deployment enum: 'indoor' or 'outdoor'. weightGrams is unit weight in grams.

products.name: Ubiquiti UniFi U7 Pro XGS
products.priceNote: Ubiquiti US Store (store.ui.com/us/en/products/u7-pro-xgs) lists the U7 Pro XGS (SKU U7-Pro-XGS-B, Black) at $299.00 verbatim — US MSRP for the AP alone; UI Care ($59.00/unit) and the 10G PoE++ Adapter ($39.00) are priced separately.
products.provenance: The Ubiquiti tech-specs page (techspecs.ui.com/unifi/wifi/u7-pro-xgs) confirms the exact model "U7 Pro XGS" (U7-Pro-XGS) and states verbatim: WiFi 7, a single 10 GbE RJ45 uplink port, PoE++ power method, 29W max power consumption, "500+" max client count, and 800 g weight. The Ubiquiti US Store page confirms the same product under SKU U7-Pro-XGS-B (Black) at $299.00 US MSRP and describes it as an 8-stream WiFi 7 AP with 10 GbE support, corroborating identity and price. Both pages match the target exactly and rule out siblings listed alongside it (U7 Pro, U7 Pro XG, U7 Pro Max). maxAggregateRateGbps, antennaType, and mountEnvironment were left null because no summed PHY rate and no explicit internal/indoor labeling appear verbatim on either fetched page.

products.name: EnGenius ECW536

products.provenance: The EnGenius manufacturer product page confirms the exact model ECW536 as a 4x4x4 tri-band Wi-Fi 7 (802.11be) indoor cloud-managed AP and provides the full spec table: 18.7 Gbps aggregate, dual 10GE ports (one PoE++), 802.3bt input, 38W max power consumption, 512 max concurrent users, integrated omni-directional antennas, and 1270g weight. The EnGenius Store page corroborates the identity ("ECW536: Cloud Managed 4x4x4 Indoor WiFi 7 Access Point") and lists the price as $599.00 for the base unit, explicitly separate from the ECW536S ($749.00) and ECW536-P ($639.00) SKUs. Both pages agree on Wi-Fi 7, tri-band, 4x4 per-radio streams, 10 Gbps uplink, 802.3bt PoE, and 18.7 Gbps aggregate; max power draw differs (38W on the manufacturer spec page vs 35W on the store), and I used the manufacturer figure.
